final: STATUS: fail SUMMARY: One reproduced blocking failure: with JavaScript off, the contact form silently sends the message into the page URL with no demo notice, which fails the project checklist's form item. The other criteria held under my probes: hostile genres, 320/360 overflow, contrast (min 7.15:1), focus rings, and the mobile menu. Mutation testing shows the suite does not prove the local-day "upcoming" rule or the event sort. FILES TOUCHED: none (probes and mutation copies lived in the scratch dir; `git status` still shows the same 13 added files) FINDINGS: - [blocking] JS-off contact form: with `javaScriptEnabled:false`, filling the form and clicking "Send enquiry" navigates to `/visit.html?name=Ada+Reader&email=ada%40example.com&subject=&message=Do+you+hold+book+club+sets%3F`. No status text and no demo notice appear. An empty submit also navigates silently. This breaks "submits somewhere real or says plainly that it's a demo", and it puts the message into the URL. Fix: `action="#"` plus JS-only enablement, or a visible "needs JavaScript" notice. - [minor] Tests miss the local-day rule: changing `todayIso()` to `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` still passes all 31 tests. The midnight test cannot distinguish local from UTC "today". - [minor] Tests miss the sort: removing `.sort(...)` from `upcomingEvents` still passes, because the chronological test only reads the already-sorted data. - [minor] `books-empty-state-message-exists` reads `textContent` of a hidden element, so it never proves the message displays. The `file://` test only checks rendering, not filter or pushState. - [minor] JS off: all four pages are empty (0 book cards, 0 filter chips, 0 events, no empty-state message). The catalogue and events are JS-rendered, which the criteria don't forbid. The menu button is visible at 360 with JS off and does nothing. - [minor] Stale mailto: after a valid submit, editing the message and clicking "Open this message in your email app" opens the email with the old draft. Reproduced. - [minor] Email check accepts `a@b..co` and `ünï@exämple.com`. Only "a@" and "foo" are required to fail, so this is not a criteria miss. - [minor] Desktop header (≥720px) puts the nav on a second row, 113px tall, right-aligned under the brand. The page is readable but not a deliberate bar layout. - [minor] README says `js/events.js` has "the upcoming filter", but that logic lives in `site.js`. Events intro says "workshops", and none are listed. - [minor] `tests/run.mjs` has unused `.svg/.png/.jpg` MIME entries and a `NAV_HREFS` list duplicating `PAGES`. CHECKS: - `NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node tests/run.mjs` (orchestrator run) → not re-run; the file has 31 `test(` calls, but the brief says 28 - Hostile genres (``, `Science+Fiction`, `%20%20Mystery%20`, `Mystère`, `__proto__`, `constructor`, `toString`, duplicate `genre=`, `mystery-`) at 1280 → pass; note text via textContent, no dialogs, no page errors - Back/forward after pushState, reload, and back after navigating away → pass (poetry restored) - JS-off renders for all four pages → fail (empty, see minor) - Overflow scrollWidth at 320 and 360 on all four pages, plus after a 3000-char message, a 90-char unbroken name, a long email, and a long genre note → pass (320 and 360) - Contrast (computed text, blended alpha) on all four pages, 360 menu open, form errors, form demo, and books filtered → pass (min 7.15:1) - Focus ring (3px solid, ≥3:1) on skip link, brand, nav and first chips, desktop books → pass - Mobile menu at 320 and 360 with keyboard (Tab to Menu, Enter opens, Tab reaches Home, Escape closes, focus returns) → pass - Events local-midnight in Kiritimati and LA, plus 2026-11-20 23:59 LA, 2026-11-28 Pago Pago, and 2026-12-12 LA → pass; home shows two events - Events and home with all events in the past, or none → empty message shown, list hidden → pass - Form: "a b@c.de", "a@b", "@b.co", "a@@b.co" rejected; whitespace name/message → rejected; Enter-key submit focuses first invalid → pass - Form: `` and `
